shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat AGENTS.md && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.git'"' -g '"'!.agents/**'"'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Card Switch useThemeValue ThemeProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh yagr && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Switch useThemeValue ThemeProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist -g '*.d.ts' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/cursor/cursor.d.ts && sed -n '90,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && rg -n -C 3 'setTheme\\(|setSeries\\(|setTimeline\\(|dispose\\(|resizeOb|timeMultiplier|preserve' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | head -180 && sed -n '83,151p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '7730,7803p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs && sed -n '7960,7998p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs && rg -n 'dispose\\(\\)|onResize =|reflow\\(|setData\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | tail -22 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/mixins/batch-updates.d.ts && sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/legend/legend.d.ts && rg -n 'export.*setTheme|function useTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 5 'min.*scale.min|scaleConfig.min|scales\\[.*\\].min|min:.*min|range:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | tail -110 && sed -n '930,953p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs && sed -n '7520,7547p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs && cat vite.config.ts && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '6265,6308p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs && rg -n -C 2 'setThemeImpl|AXIS_STROKE|GRID\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | head -60 && rg -n -C 2 'min =|min:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | tail -35 && rg -n -- '--g-spacing-(4|5|6|8)|--g-color-text-info|--g-color-base-info-light' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '6305,6325p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs && sed -n '8190,8228p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs && rg -n -C 2 'toLocale|tooltip.*title|dateTime|formatDate|utc|UTC' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | head -80 && sed -n '1,85p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts && rg -n 'ResizeObserver|adaptive' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | tail -8"
